# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Rises from the Jordan

---

**1** When Adam heard all this from the devil, he wept and cried out: 'Lord my God, my life is in your hands! Drive this enemy away from me — he wants to destroy my soul. Give me back the glory he forfeited.'

**2** The Lord heard Adam's prayer and sent Michael the archangel, who drove the devil far away from Adam.

**3** 'Rise up, Adam, and come out of the water,' Michael the archangel said. 'The Lord has heard your penance and forgiven you. He will restore you to paradise — with all of its commandments.'

**4** Adam came out of the water. His skin was withered like dried grass from the cold.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
